english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something deliberately kept from other people, including a secret passage.
Use 秘密 when the emphasis is simply on something being secret or hidden, without the subcultural sense carried by 地下.
Use this for information or communications kept private and away from discovery.

examples.english: This is a secret, so don't tell anyone.
examples.traditional: 呢件事係秘密，你唔好同人講。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 bei3 mat6 nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2

examples.english: They held an underground meeting in secret because they did not want anyone to know.
examples.traditional: 佢哋秘密咁開會，唔想畀人知道。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bei3 mat6 gam3 hoi1 wui2 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 dou3

examples.english: This conversation is secure, so don't let anyone see it.
examples.traditional: 呢段對話係秘密嚟㗎，唔好畀人睇到。
examples.jyutping: nei1 dyun6 deoi3 waa6 hai6 bei3 mat6 lai4 gaa3 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tai2 dou2
